notes.Window:
initialX / initialY are normalized values between 0 and 1 (top-left corner), not pixel values.
id (a property of WindowParam) refers to a singleton identity or is obtained using "byId" – it is not Meta.id.
Opening from a button: uses the same .script, recipes.X, and wapi.addSingletonWindow (never uses a local api = …, and never uses util.useFn).
Size: expanded=true, combined with CSS !window-expanded.
Padding: on the Window it also shifts the title bar and the close button; for the content only, use a Window!<class> Window::Content rule.
notes.BoxLayout:
When empty (no children), its gravity has no effect in game: an empty { -1, -1 } box does not act as a spacer and does not push its neighbours.
For a spacer, use “Horizontal / Vertical spacer” from the palette (empty Component, the game's pattern).
notes.Component: No background or minimum size in game. Empty, with the horizontal-spacer or vertical-spacer class, it is the game's spacer (see the palette).
notes.FloatingLayout: Stacks its FloatingLayoutChild items in the same frame (badge, icon over an image, button in a corner). A very common pattern in the game (118 FloatingLayout, 296 children).
notes.FloatingLayoutChild: Places its item inside the FloatingLayout: h and v work like a gravity (-1 fills, 0 start, 0.5 centre, 1 end). overflowMode = Overflow: the item may leave the frame (ignores padding and spacing).
notes.AbsoluteLayout:
The `AbsoluteLayout` is a function({TreeNodeId}) that returns a `TreeNodeId`, not a recipe – it is manually injected into the catalog.
No game Lua file uses it. Generated as builtin.AbsoluteLayout with its children as a plain list: no props or meta (classes, style). AbsoluteLayoutChild only has localKey and item: no known position, to be checked in game.
notes.ScrollArea:
Always with content in the base game (52/52). Empty: the game is likely to crash.
No background in game; shrinks to the available space and scrolls according to horizontalPolicy / verticalPolicy (AlwaysOff = clipped without a bar, AlwaysOn, AsNeeded).
notes.TextView: Centered vertically within a BoxLayout, without being stretched (observed during gameplay, but not present in the base documentation).
notes.ImageView: Displayed size: the size style property (the size prop gives the pixels of data / data_native and has no effect on a path image; coord = grid of an animation sheet with numFrames). A backgroundColor is not drawn (seen in game).
notes.ComboBox: Still with all the items included in the base game (23/23).
notes.ComboBoxItem: Always with some content (e.g., a TextView) and a value set in the base game (39/39).
notes.Slider:
Horizontal (defect): Stretches in width, height 16 (builtin.css.lua `Slider!horizontal`); vertical: the opposite.
The track is centered within the height of the element (observed in the game).
notes.TextInputField:
It expands in both height and width in its layout (as observed in the game, but not reflected in the base files). This expansion also affects the BoxLayout that contains it.
The background covers the entire expanded height, and the text entered is vertically centered (as observed in the game).
notes.ProgressBar: It stretches along both axes (gravity {-1, -1}, height 20 in builtin.css.lua): it also stretches its parent layout.
notes.List:
`selectionIndex` and `onSelect` are 1-based (Lua indices).
No background in game; stretches and follows the window: when space runs out, the list is clipped and scrolls (verticalScrollBarPolicy / horizontalScrollBarPolicy: AlwaysOff = clipped without a bar, AlwaysOn, AsNeeded). drawBackground: appearance not verified.
notes.DataTable: ⚠ Unstable behavior when using a non-entity `rowKey` — can cause unrecoverable React crashes. It is recommended to use `TableLayout` or `BoxLayout` instead.
